hybrid@150000.note: Matched to 150k (was 75k). Modest improvement across the board vs 75k: BPB single 2.535->2.494, cross 2.841->2.791, LAMBADA ppl 396->381. Switch acc flat (34.85%->34.35%, noise). More steps helped a little but did not change the ranking.

hybrid@75000.note: GradNorm fixed switch acc (27->35%) but lost cross-domain edge; 75k not matched to 150k. LAMBADA ppl=396.23 - beats baseline/SOTA by a wide margin, between pooled (280.5) and routed3 (3199).

pooled2@150000.note: GradNorm + sparse top-2/16 routing, no confidence head - matched to 150k. Regression vs original pooled on every metric: BPB single 2.409 vs 2.384, cross 2.223 vs 2.135, switch 25.1% vs 27.4%, LAMBADA 312.9 vs 280.5. Cross-domain still beats single-domain (2.223 vs 2.409) - the switching-arm compression effect holds - but the GradNorm+sparse-routing change did not help.

pooled@150000.note: FINAL - plateau confirmed: 68k more steps moved BPB by 0.013. LAMBADA ppl=280.52 - beats unified-BPE baseline/SOTA by a wide margin but well behind routed (47.76) and mot (148.4).

routed-large@40000.note: SCALE TEST snapshot, 27% through training (40k/150k) - NOT final. Already matches or beats the fully-trained 89M champion (BPB single 2.002 vs 2.075, cross 1.541 vs 1.544, switch 28.8% vs 26%) with 110k steps left. LAMBADA slightly behind (56.8 vs 47.76) but converging. Early positive signal for scale survival.

routed-large@52000.note: SCALE TEST snapshot, 35% through training (52k/150k) - NOT final. Now BEATS the fully-trained 89M champion on every metric (BPB single 1.889 vs 2.075, cross 1.419 vs 1.544, LAMBADA 41.3 vs 47.76), and exact-match jumped to 1.6% (vs champions 0.4%) - first arm all session to climb meaningfully off the near-zero floor. 98k steps still remain. Strong positive trajectory for scale survival, still pending the real comparison vs baseline-large.

routed2@150000.note: GradNorm loss ONLY (isolates the loss fix, no other changes) - matched to 150k. Severe regression vs routed champion: BPB single 3.387 vs 2.075 (+63%), cross 2.823 vs 1.544 (+83%), LAMBADA 1598 vs 47.76 (33x worse). Switch acc improved (33.5% vs 26%). Third GradNorm variant (with routed3, pooled2) showing the same trade: switch-prediction gains at a severe cost to language modeling quality. This isolates the loss-function change alone as the culprit, not data density or routing sparsity.

routed3@150000.note: GradNorm + 2.4x denser cross-domain data. Switch acc improved (35% vs routed champion 26%) but BPB nearly doubled and LAMBADA collapsed (3199 vs 48) - the denser data variant badly hurt LM quality despite the switch-prediction gain.

routed@150000.note: CHAMPION - best LAMBADA + cross-domain of any arm; improved from 100k

sota@123000.note: cl100k 100k vocab; worst LAMBADA - vocab is a liability at this scale
